event: Two days left: before dawn on Day 16 Wren sits with her palms flat on the threshold stone.
Since Familiar she has sat here every dawn, as the healer did, just to say hello.
The thirty-second dawn vibration reaches her through her palms and then the bond.
She writes in the margin column: Day 16. Two remain.
She finds a worn track from the healer's house past the hall to the threshold stone.
It is the healer's daily route, worn deepest at the gathering hall's entrance.
Her palm on the compacted earth finds it holds warmth longer than the loose soil.
The [Wayfinder's Eye] shimmer traces the whole path as one continuous feature.
A discovery logs the healer's daily route, discovery 14: +43 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: healer's daily route worn into the settlement's ground

event: She spends the morning at the stone's northern face.
A pale vertical vein cuts the banding: a crack that sealed itself before anyone came.
Tapped with a fingernail, the vein rings higher and brighter than the limestone.
A discovery logs the healed fault, discovery 15: +46 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: threshold stone's self-sealed fault on the northern face

event: The fault runs to just below the handprint: geology and people on opposite faces.
In early afternoon Theron comes from the west, tracing the settlement's drainage channel.
His father, born here, waded in it as a boy and called it the little river.
His father never came back: 'He said there was nothing to come back to.'
Theron says the drainage still works: cleared of silt, the water would flow right.
'It means the builders were good at drainage.' Theron laughs for the first time.
'Yes. They were good at drainage.' He walks north toward camp.
In the late afternoon she goes into the gap, and the bond compresses.
The ghost-elm hum is absent inside; a faint vibration runs in the ground from the south.
Her hand on the dead tree finds it conducting the corruption's precursor tremor.
A discovery logs the pre-pulse tremor, compression multiplier, discovery 16: +58 XP.

changes.note: Discovery in the gap: pre-pulse tremor, compression multiplier

event: She sits at the threshold stone and lets the bond recover from the compression.
Before dawn on Day 17 the stone's vibration stops after twelve seconds.
The precursor tremor now runs in the ground beneath the whole settlement.
She writes: Day 17, one remains; this is compression from the stone's side.
Mid-morning a low grey cloud ceiling moves in from the south.
At the northern face she feels the stone not singing, with no direct sun to drive it.
For an hour she feels the steady frequency under all others: the stone's resting tone.
A discovery logs the resting tone, found only under cloud, discovery 17: +48 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: threshold stone's resting tone under cloud cover

event: She learns to tell the stone's own voice from the corruption's approaching one.
At midday Theron sits beside her at the stone: 'The healer used to do this.'
His grandmother said the healer sat at the stone each morning, and thought it prayer.
Wren says she is not praying or surveying or working. 'Being here,' Theron says.
He says again that the healer used to do this, now as recognition.
'Tomorrow is Day 18.' This pulse is different: the gap is larger, the precursor earlier.
For the first time he will be at the settlement for a pulse. 'Thank you,' she says.
He nods once and goes north.
In the afternoon she enters the gap again; the precursor comes from south-southeast.
The ghost-elms brace, their shimmer pulled tight against the wood.
Her hand on the dead tree: the precursor's vibration hums in her teeth and jaw.
She feels the compression and the precursor as one thing: the corruption pressing in.
The shimmer at the gap's edges is dimmer; the precursor is deepening the gap.
She steps back across the ward boundary and breathes. One day.
That night she lies awake in camp with the tremor under her bedroll.
Seventeen discoveries; Known at an anchor may need sixteen to twenty-four.
She thinks of Fell at the fen, and of the healer at the stone each dawn.
She does not try to sleep, and lets the not-sleeping be information.
On Day 18 she is at the threshold stone before the sky shows light.
The dawn vibration does not come: the precursor has taken the stone's voice.
She holds the stone as it tries to sing and fails, and tries again.
Under lower cloud on the pulse day she writes: dawn vibration absent. Zero.
She works the grey morning without urgency.
A cupped oval on the western face holds fine parallel grooves: carved, not worn.
Someone marked the stone before the settlement was ever built.
A discovery logs the pre-settlement carving, discovery 18: +44 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: pre-settlement carving on the threshold stone's western face

event: Four faces have shown four histories, in the order the stone chose.
Palm on the carving, holding the resting tone, she feels the bond deepen quietly.
She knows the stone now, as the healer knew it, and the sleeper wakes.
The warmth spreads from her sternum into a field she stands inside.
The bond deepens to Known; [Dormant] resolves into [Enduring]: +2 ADP, +1 VIT.
[Foundation Stone] is revealed and the triad chord sounds in full: +150 XP.

changes.note: Bond deepened: threshold stone, Familiar to Known

event: [Tended] and [Kept] brighten; the triad gains a bass note she feels in her feet.
With the stone awake beneath her and the pulse approaching, she does not move. She holds.
At midday the insects and ghost-elms fall silent and the pulse moves north underground.
All five bonds flex at once; all ten connections carry the pulse.
Corruption tendrils thread through the gap into the settlement's margin.
[Foundation Stone] flares through the substrate, and the tendrils stop.
The stone fills the space the corruption needs, as the precursor once silenced the stone.
The main wave pours through the dead tree as the ghost-elms brace.
The triad passes the corruption through [Enduring], [Tended] and [Kept]; it exits as information.
She understands the bond network is not protection but translation.
The pressure is immense: she is sixteen and has been asked to contain the stone.
The Holding's pull is right there, the edge where Fell and the fen became one.
She holds herself: her name, the rosemary, her parents, Theron's laugh, Brecca.
The stone, complete without her, gives the Holding nothing to close around.
The pulse ebbs north; the dead tree stops conducting and the ghost-elm shimmer widens.
LEVEL UP: Wren reaches Level 5, with +3 free points and Apprentice Surveying.

changes.note: Level up after the Day 18 pulse
Level 5 Wayfinder class bonus (ch12: PER 13 with the class bonus)

event: The stone sings a song wholly its own, arriving in her chest as: I am still here.
The gap stopped at the signature's radius; for once a pulse did not widen it.
She sat with a stone and paid attention for two weeks; that was all, and it was enough.
After hours of sitting she stands on unsteady legs, bracing on the warm stone.
Theron stands at the drainage channel's edge, where he stood through the pulse.
'The gap didn't grow.' 'No.' He looks at the stone: 'Good drainage.'
They walk back to camp in the quiet after a held breath releases.
At the fire she writes: Day 18. The stone woke. The pulse came. The gap held.
She touches the rosemary in her jacket pocket; she is still here, too.
